summary: Flexible content card block with multiple styles and media support.
features: Entire card becomes clickable when button or link added
shortDescription: The Card block provides a versatile content container in Studio for displaying mixed media and text. It offers three visual styles (plain, outline, haptic) to match different design contexts. Image display settings control the ratio and orientation independently of the source media, allowing consistent card layouts. Content areas include heading, body text, optional button, and text link. When any interactive element is added, the entire card surface becomes clickable for improved usability.
